claims.quote: We identified 21 gene variants (ACMG III: n = 7, ACMG IV: n = 2, ACMG V: n = 12) in 19 patients (45.2%) in the genes TSC1, TSC2, MECP2, DEPDC5, HUWE1, GRIN1, ASH1I, TRIO, KIF5C, CDON, ANKD11, TGFBR2, ATN1, COL4A1, JAK2, KCNQ2, ATP1A2, and GLI3 by whole-exome sequencing as well as deletions and duplications by array CGH in six patients.
